note: RFC 1334 Section 2.2.2: "If the Peer-ID/Password pair received in a Authenticate-Request is not recognizable or acceptable, then the authenticator MUST transmit a PAP packet with the Code field set to 3 (Authenticate-Nak), and SHOULD take action to terminate the link." Rejudged statically at HEAD. Code 3 on reject is enforced: TestPAPRejectWritesNak asserts payload[0]==PAPAuthenticateNak, and TestPAPRequestEmitsEvent asserts Ack on accept. The clause 'a PAP packet' is not: TestPAPRejectWritesNak discards the protocol (`_, payload := readPeerFrame`), and the only ProtoPAP assertion is on the Ack in the other test. A reject path that framed Code 3 under another Protocol stays green. Today pap.go writes both replies under one WriteFrame(ProtoPAP) before the branch, so the code complies and this is a test gap, not a product defect. Fix: assert proto==ProtoPAP on the reply in TestPAPRejectWritesNak. The SHOULD half is RFC1334-2.3-5 and is not claimed here.
